parameters.query:
WITH selected_leads AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (al.metadata->>'loan_request_id')
        al.id,
        al.tenant_id,
        al.campaign_id,
        c.id                                     AS conversation_id,
        c.status                                 AS conversation_status,
        COALESCE(c.agent_id, a.id)               AS agent_id,
        a.evolution_instance,
        a.whatsapp_provider                      AS provider,
        a.meta_api_token,
        a.meta_phone_number_id,
        a.zenvia_api_token,
        a.zenvia_channel_id,
        al.identifier                            AS cnpj,
        al.whatsapp                              AS phone,
        al.name,
        (al.metadata->>'loan_request_id')        AS loan_request_id,
        (al.metadata->>'requested_amount')       AS requested_amount,
        (al.metadata->>'fiserv_status')          AS current_fiserv_status,
        (al.metadata->>'fiserv_external_status')  AS current_external_status,
        (al.metadata->>'fiserv_offer_sent')      AS fiserv_offer_sent
    FROM agent_leads al
    -- 1. Garante que SÓ traz leads que têm conversa REAL com o bot
    JOIN conversations c 
        ON c.tenant_id = al.tenant_id 
       AND (
           c.user_identifier = al.whatsapp 
           OR c.user_identifier = RIGHT(al.whatsapp, 11)
           OR c.user_identifier = regexp_replace(al.whatsapp, '^55', '')
       )
    -- 2. Puxa os dados do canal do agente ativo
    LEFT JOIN agents a 
        ON a.tenant_id = al.tenant_id 
       AND a.status = 'active'
    WHERE al.metadata->>'fiserv_status' IN (
        'in_progress','fail_to_contact','contact_updated',
        'comite','in_quoting','comite_approved','formalization'
      )
      AND al.metadata->>'loan_request_id' IS NOT NULL
      AND (al.metadata->>'fiserv_offer_sent') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
      AND ((al.metadata->>'fiserv_requested_at') IS NULL OR (al.metadata->>'fiserv_requested_at')::timestamptz > now() - interval '7 days')
      -- 🛡️ TRAVA ANTI-SOBREPOSIÇÃO (RACE CONDITION): Ignora se outra execução já bloqueou este lead nos últimos 3 minutos
      AND (
          al.metadata->>'fiserv_polling_at' IS NULL
          OR (al.metadata->>'fiserv_polling_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '3 minutes'
      )
      -- 🛡️ BLINDAGEM 1: Ignora se QUALQUER linha desse CNPJ/loan já teve oferta enviada
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM agent_leads al_check
          WHERE al_check.tenant_id = al.tenant_id
            AND (
                al_check.metadata->>'loan_request_id' = al.metadata->>'loan_request_id'
                OR al_check.identifier = al.identifier
            )
            AND al_check.metadata->>'fiserv_offer_sent' = 'true'
      )
      -- 🛡️ BLINDAGEM 2: Trava anti-duplicidade no histórico de mensagens da conversa (oferta ou recusa)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM messages m
          WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
            AND m.direction = 'outbound'
            AND (
                m.content ILIKE '%Boa notícia%'
                OR m.content ILIKE '%não conseguimos liberar%'
                OR m.content ILIKE '%nao conseguimos liberar%'
            )
            AND m.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
      )
    -- 3. Prioriza a conversa mais recente caso haja duplicatas
    ORDER BY (al.metadata->>'loan_request_id'), c.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 100
),
locked_leads AS (
    -- 🔒 LOCK ATÔMICO IMEDIATO: Carimba fiserv_polling_at neste exato milissegundo.
    -- Se o próximo cron rodar daqui a 1 minuto enquanto este ainda estiver consultando a Fiserv,
    -- o próximo cron verá este lead bloqueado e NÃO repetirá a consulta nem o envio!
    UPDATE agent_leads al_upd
    SET metadata = al_upd.metadata || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_polling_at', now()::text)
    FROM selected_leads sl
    WHERE al_upd.id = sl.id
)
SELECT * FROM selected_leads;

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent_leads
SET metadata = metadata
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_status', 
        CASE 
          WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'approved' THEN 'comite_approved'
          ELSE '{{ $json.status }}'
        END
      )
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_external_status', '{{ ($json.external_status || "") }}'::text)
   || (CASE 
         WHEN '{{ $json.decided }}' = 'true' 
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'fiserv_offer_data', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.offer_data || {}) }}'::jsonb,
           'fiserv_amount_approved', '{{ $json.approved_limit || $json.offer_data?.SomaPrincipal || $json.offer_data?.amount || "" }}',
           'max_installments', '{{ $json.max_installments || $json.offer_data?.installments || "" }}'
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb 
       END)
   || (CASE 
         WHEN '{{ $json.has_simulation }}' = 'true'
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'simularam', true,
           'simulation_requested', true,
           'simulated_at', now(),
           'requested_installments', '{{ $json.simulated_installments || 24 }}'::numeric,
           'simulation_data', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.simulation_data || {}) }}'::jsonb
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb
       END)
   || (CASE 
         -- PASSO 5: Quando o comitê formaliza / liquida o crédito (WON)
         WHEN lower('{{ $json.status }}') IN ('won', 'formalized', 'contract_signed', 'disbursed')
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'formalization_status', 'formalized',
           'formalized_at', now(),
           'formalized_amount', COALESCE(
             NULLIF('{{ $json.offer_data?.SomaPrincipal || $json.offer_data?.amount || "" }}', '')::numeric,
             (metadata->'accepted_proposal'->>'amount')::numeric,
             (metadata->'simulation_data'->>'amount')::numeric
           ),
           'formalized_installments', COALESCE(
             NULLIF('{{ $json.offer_data?.installments || "" }}', '')::numeric,
             (metadata->'accepted_proposal'->>'installments')::numeric,
             (metadata->'simulation_data'->>'installments')::numeric
           )
         )
         -- Quando a proposta é reprovada na mesa de formalização
         WHEN lower('{{ $json.status }}') IN ('lost', 'denied', 'cancelled', 'fails_to_process')
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'formalization_status', 'lost',
           'lost_at', now(),
           'lost_reason', '{{ ($json.external_status || "recusado_mesa_credito") }}'
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb 
       END)
WHERE (id = '{{ $json._row_id }}'::uuid OR metadata->>'loan_request_id' = '{{ $json.loan_request_id }}')
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $json._tenant_id }}'::uuid;

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    c.id                       AS conversation_id,
    c.status                   AS conversation_status,
    COALESCE(c.agent_id, a.id) AS agent_id,
    a.evolution_instance,
    a.whatsapp_provider        AS provider,
    a.meta_api_token,
    a.meta_phone_number_id,
    a.zenvia_api_token,
    a.zenvia_channel_id
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN agents a 
    ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id 
   AND a.status = 'active'
WHERE (
    c.id = NULLIF('{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').item.json._conversation_id || "" }}', '')::uuid
    OR (
        c.tenant_id = '{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').item.json._tenant_id }}'::uuid
        AND (
            c.user_identifier = '{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').item.json._phone }}'
            OR c.user_identifier = RIGHT('{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').item.json._phone }}', 11)
            OR c.user_identifier = regexp_replace('{{ $('Consolidar Mensagem e Status').item.json._phone }}', '^55', '')
        )
    )
)
-- 🛡️ ULTIMATE GATE: Se outra execução acabou de salvar uma mensagem de oferta nos últimos 60 segundos, ABORTA!
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM messages m
    WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
      AND m.direction = 'outbound'
      AND (
          m.content ILIKE '%Boa notícia%'
          OR m.content ILIKE '%não conseguimos liberar%'
          OR m.content ILIKE '%nao conseguimos liberar%'
      )
      AND m.created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds'
)
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
